title: Chibi town: pixel art from simple 3D
about: A handheld-RPG look: 480 × 270, a camera straight on and 45° down so a metre is 16 px on the ground and up a wall, one palette, inked outlines. People are a few boxes 29 px tall with big heads and painted faces (samples/lib/chibi.js), posed in code at 8 frames a second. The street is painted: facades, signs and the ground are pixel textures on boxes (samples/lib/pixeltown.js). Night lights the windows, signs and lamps.
